extracted.intended_audience: postdoctoral researchers preparing an NIDDK K99/R00 (Pathway to Independence) application
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and requirements for preparing and submitting an NIDDK K99/R00 Pathway to Independence application, including eligibility, effort, funding limits, and the conditions for transition to the R00 phase.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program purpose
rubrics_metrics.description: The K99/R00 program is designed to facilitate a timely transition from a mentored postdoctoral research position to a stable independent research position with independent NIH or other research support at an earlier stage than is currently the norm.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes shortening postdoctoral time and facilitating transition to independent NIH Research Grant Program (R01) funding.

rubrics_metrics.name: K99 (mentored) phase location and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: The mentored K99 phase of the award may take place either within NIH Intramural Programs or at any extramural research institution and lasts 1-2 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should plan for 1–2 years of mentored support; K99 may occur at NIH intramural or extramural sites.

rubrics_metrics.name: R00 (independent) phase location and duration
rubrics_metrics.description: Only extramural research institutions are eligible sites for the independent R00 phase of the award which lasts up to 3 years.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: R00 requires an extramural (non-NIH intramural) eligible institution; plan up to 3 years of independent support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding caps and NIDDK contribution
rubrics_metrics.description: The K99 phase has a total cost cap of $90,000 per year. The R00 phase of the award has a total cost limit of $249,000 per year. NIDDK will provide up to $75,000 per year for salary, appropriate fringe benefits, and up to $25,000 per year for research support.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Budget proposals must respect these total cost limits and NIDDK contribution breakdown when requesting support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Degree requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have a Ph.D., M.D., or have an equivalent professional or clinical doctorate.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only candidates with doctoral-level credentials (or equivalent professional/clinical doctorates) are eligible.

rubrics_metrics.name: Postdoctoral experience limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must have no more than 4 years of postdoctoral research experience at the time of the initial application or the subsequent resubmission.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Count postdoctoral research experience carefully to ensure eligibility; see NOT-OD-20-011 for possible extensions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Appropriate need for mentored support
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants requiring less than 12 months of mentored research training and career development are not ideal candidates for this award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants should justify needing 1–2 more years of mentored support to become competitive for a faculty position; very short remaining mentored needs weaken suitability.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum effort requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must be available to devote a minimum of 9 calendar months (75 percent of the year) worth of effort to this project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan institutional commitments and effort allocation to meet the 75% effort requirement throughout the K99 period.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clear milestones in research and career development
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must present clear milestones in their research and career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications should include specific, time-bound milestones that demonstrate progress toward independence and readiness for R00 transition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Minimum K99 duration to be considered for R00
rubrics_metrics.description: NIDDK requires at least 12 months at the K99 phase to be considered for the R00 transition.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Plan K99 start and end dates so that at least 12 months of mentored K99 support occur before requesting transition to R00.

rubrics_metrics.name: R00 transition condition — employment requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Receipt of the R00 award is dependent upon the applicant obtaining a tenure-track, full-time faculty position (assistant professor or equivalent) at an eligible U.S. institution (typically not at the K99 Institution).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Transition to R00 is contingent on securing an eligible independent faculty position; R00 will generally not be awarded at the K99 institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Evidence of ability to remain in the United States
rubrics_metrics.description: Applicants must provide evidence that they can remain in the United States for the duration of the K99 award period. At the time of review for the R00 phase, evidence must be provided that the applicant can remain in the United States for the duration of the R00 award period.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Non-U.S. citizens/permanent residents must document visas/authorization sufficient to cover the award periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: R00 evaluation process
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluation of R00 applications is conducted by NIDDK Program (not peer review).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Understand that programmatic review (NIDDK) — not the usual peer review panel — evaluates R00 transition requests; align transition materials with program expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Citizenship requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: U.S. citizenship or permanent resident status is not required.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants may be non-citizens but must demonstrate ability to remain in the U.S. for award durations (see evidence requirement).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research topic eligibility
rubrics_metrics.description: NIDDK encourages K99/R00 applications in all areas of research supported by the NIDDK.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Proposed research should fall within NIDDK's supported domains; consult institute resources or program staff if uncertain.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required application materials and timing for transition
rubrics_metrics.description: Submit a complete application package. Submit 6 months prior to the end of the K99 period for a smooth transition to the R00 portion of the award.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare and submit a full application package in time to allow institutional and programmatic processing; leaving ~6 months helps ensure seamless transition.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadlines for new applications and resubmissions
rubrics_metrics.description: New Applications: February 12, June 12, October 12. Resubmissions: March 12, July 12, November 12.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Adhere to standard NIH receipt dates for new and revised submissions; plan timelines (institutional approvals, budgets, letters) accordingly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staff contact for program guidance
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact the appropriate program director from the list of Career Development Staff Contacts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Engage NIDDK program staff early for advice on fit, eligibility, and application planning.
